changeSet.author: vsds
changeSet.comment:
Fix for https://github.com/OpenLDES/LDESServer/issues/48: "Ingested members are not found in views".
Until now a member was offered to the bucketization step for as long as members.is_fragmented was false. That flag is kept per member, so the first view that fragmented a member hid it from every other view of the same collection, and a view that was added afterwards never saw the already fragmented members at all.
The processable_members database view is therefore replaced by a table that links every member to every view of its collection and that tracks the "is fragmented" state per (member, view) pair.
changeSet.sql: -- the bucketisation step only reads the members that still have to be fragmented for a single view create index processable_members_unfragmented_idx on processable_members (view_id, member_id) where is_fragmented = false

-- a member has been fragmented for a view as soon as it has been bucketised into that view insert into processable_members (member_id, view_id, collection_id, is_fragmented) select m.member_id, v.view_id, m.collection_id, exists (select 1 from page_members pm where pm.member_id = m.member_id and pm.view_id = v.view_id) from members m join views v on v.collection_id = m.collection_id
-- add processable members after members inserted create trigger members_ai after insert on members referencing new table as new_members for each statement execute procedure on_members_inserted();

create function on_view_inserted_add_processable_members() returns trigger language plpgsql as $$ begin -- ingestion locks the collection row before it inserts its members, so taking that same lock here makes -- sure that a concurrently ingested member is picked up either by this statement or by the members_ai trigger perform 1 from collections where collection_id = NEW.collection_id for update;
insert into processable_members (member_id, view_id, collection_id) select m.member_id, NEW.view_id, NEW.collection_id from members m where m.collection_id = NEW.collection_id on conflict do nothing; return null; end $$;
-- add processable members after view inserted create trigger views_ai_processable_members after insert on views for each row execute procedure on_view_inserted_add_processable_members();
changeSet.createView: select pm.member_id, pm.collection_id, pm.view_id from processable_members pm where pm.is_fragmented = false
select v.collection_id, v.view_id, (exists (select um.member_id from unprocessed_members um where v.view_id = um.view_id)) as should_bucketize from views v group by v.collection_id, v.view_id

select c.collection_id, c.name as collection_name, v.view_id, v.name as view_name from collections c join views v on c.collection_id = v.collection_id join needs_bucketization nb on nb.collection_id = c.collection_id and nb.view_id = v.view_id join needs_pagination np on np.collection_id = c.collection_id and np.view_id = v.view_id where nb.should_bucketize or np.should_paginate
